sources.title: Agreement between the European Union and the Republic of Colombia on the short-stay visa waiver
sources.publisher: Official Journal of the European Union
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Journal agreement hosted by EUR-Lex, the Publications Office of the European Union.
sources.supportingExcerpt: This Agreement provides for visa-free travel for the citizens of the Union and for the citizens of Colombia.

sources.title: Council Decision (EU) 2015/2399 on the signing and provisional application of the Agreement
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Journal Council decision hosted by EUR-Lex, the Publications Office of the European Union.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreement shall be applied on a provisional basis as from the day following the date of signature thereof.

sources.title: Corrigendum to Information relating to the entry into force of the Agreement
sources.officialityEvidence: Official Journal corrigendum hosted by EUR-Lex, the Publications Office of the European Union.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreement between the European Union and Colombia will enter into force on 1 January 2017.

policies.title: Colombian ordinary passports: EU short-stay visa waiver
policies.summary: Colombian citizens holding valid ordinary passports may enter covered EU Member States without a visa for short stays.
conditions: Applies to valid ordinary Colombian passports; Article 3 also expressly includes diplomatic, service, official and special passports.
Does not apply to travel to carry out a paid activity; those visa rules remain subject to EU, Member State and Colombian law.
Maximum stay is 90 days in any 180-day period; the moving 180-day period counts a continuous visit or several visits.
The 90-day period in Member States fully applying the Schengen acquis is independent of each non-fully-applying Member State's 90-day period.
Ireland is expressly excluded; the agreement does not establish access there.
For France and the Netherlands, the agreement applies only to their European territories.
The agreement was provisionally applied from 3 December 2015 and entered into force on 1 January 2017.

policies.title: Covered EU ordinary passports: Colombia short-stay visa waiver
policies.summary: Citizens of covered EU Member States holding valid ordinary passports may enter Colombia without a visa for short stays.
conditions: Applies to valid ordinary passports issued by covered EU Member States; Article 3 also expressly includes diplomatic, service, official and special passports.
Ireland is excluded from the agreement's definition of Member State; the United Kingdom was also excluded and is not in this batch's EU codes.
Does not apply to travel to carry out a paid activity; those visa rules remain subject to EU, Member State and Colombian law.
Maximum stay in Colombia is 90 days in any 180-day period; the moving 180-day period counts a continuous visit or several visits.
The agreement was provisionally applied from 3 December 2015 and entered into force on 1 January 2017.
